title: Metal ion activation and DNA recognition by the Deinococcus radiodurans manganese sensor DR2539.
authors: Mota, Cristiano; Webster, Myles; Saidi, Melissa; Kapp, Ulrike; Zubieta, Chloe; Giachin, Gabriele; Manso, Jose Antonio; de Sanctis, Daniele
one_liner_zh: 该研究通过生物物理分析和晶体结构解析了耐辐射奇球菌锰传感器DR2539的金属离子激活及与DNA的识别机制，虽非典型TF-DNA体系，但涉及蛋白-DNA互作界面和AlphaFold建模，方法可迁移至TF-DNA研究。
abstract: The accumulation of manganese ions is crucial for scavenging reactive oxygen species and protecting the proteome of Deinococcus radiodurans (Dr). However, metal homeostasis still needs to be tightly regulated to avoid toxicity. DR2539, a dimeric transcription regulator, plays a key role in Dr manganese homeostasis. Despite comprising three well-conserved domains - a DNA-binding domain, a dimerisation domain, and an ancillary domain - the mechanisms underlying both, metal ion activation and DNA recognition remain elusive. In this study, we present biophysical analyses and the structure of the dimerisation and DNA-binding domains of DR2539 in its holo-form and in complex with the 21 base pair pseudo-palindromic repeat of the dr1709 promoter region, shedding light on these activation and recognition mechanisms. The dimer presents eight manganese binding sites that induce structural conformations essential for DNA binding. The analysis of the protein-DNA interfaces elucidates the significance of Tyr59 and helix alpha3 sequence in the interaction with the DNA. Finally, the structure in solution as determined by small-angle X-ray scattering experiments and supported by AlphaFold modeling provides a model illustrating the conformational changes induced upon metal binding.
abstract_zh: 锰离子的积累对于清除活性氧物种和保护耐辐射奇球菌（Deinococcus radiodurans, Dr）的蛋白质组至关重要。然而，金属稳态仍需严格调控以避免毒性。DR2539，一种二聚体转录调控因子，在Dr的锰稳态中发挥关键作用。尽管其包含三个高度保守的结构域——DNA结合域、二聚化结构域和辅助结构域——但金属离子激活和DNA识别的潜在机制仍不清楚。在本研究中，我们展示了DR2539二聚化结构域和DNA结合域在全息形式及与dr1709启动子区域21碱基对假回文重复序列复合物中的生物物理分析和结构，揭示了这些激活和识别机制。该二聚体呈现八个锰结合位点，这些位点诱导对DNA结合至关重要的结构构象。蛋白质-DNA界面的分析阐明了Tyr59和螺旋α3序列在与DNA相互作用中的重要性。最后，通过小角X射线散射实验确定并由AlphaFold建模支持的在溶液中的结构，提供了一个模型，展示了金属结合诱导的构象变化。
